title: Supreme Court Tariff Tuesday Strike Down?
summary: The last opinion day before the winter recess is Tuesday at 10am EST. The next time will not be until February 20. If the court strikes down the tariffs will SPY increase 2 to 4% on a relief rally? Or if upheld decrease 2 to 4% on forever “tariff tweet” uncertainty. Or issue no opinion and just let it sit for another month?submitted by/u/AdOnly627[link][comments]
